clips.title: The story
paras: In Tirisfal, the Scourge gather at Agamand Mills, close to Forsaken settlements. Deathguard Dillinger sends soldiers from Brill to break their ranks before the ruined mills become a base for attacks deeper into the glades.

The Agamand Mills once anchored Tirisfal Glades' agriculture. Since the Third War, their windmills overlook Scourge forces massing on the grounds under the Lich King's thrall. These mindless undead threaten the fledgling Forsaken holdings. If they secure the mills, they will have a base from which to push deeper into Tirisfal and strike at those settlements.

Deathguard Dillinger, who helps fortify Brill and patrols the territory, sends recruits against the Scourge. They hunt Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, along with Darkeye Bonecasters. Dillinger asks for notched ribs and blackened skulls as proof that the skeletal ranks have been broken apart and driven back toward the Plaguelands before their offensive begins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Scourge are trying to form a base at the Agamand Mills. If they do, then they can stage further attacks within Tirisfal.
The orders have been given. The Scourge in the Mills must be destroyed.
Go to the Mills. Collect Notched Ribs from Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, and Blackened Skulls from Darkeye Bonecasters.
To get to the Mills, follow the road west. After crossing the bridge, take the next fork north then keep going north. When you see windmills, the battle will begin.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, friend. Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless undead back into the Plaguelands!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your efforts in the war are felt among us, friend. I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.
